name: Nyan Nyako Nyan
source:
Main character moves to a small village on the beach. He picks up a cat-girl "Miu" to live with her, and there are also a lot of lively girls in the village to have fun with. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公搬到海边的一座小村庄。他捡到猫娘“缪”，并开始和她共同生活；村里还有许多活泼的女孩，与她们相处的日子热闹又欢乐。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
